_markedDoc: statuses.marked: Quarry (the ranged perk node) and Branding (a tier-3 skill talent) both hang this on a target. It is a plain takeMore debuff, so js/skills.js buffsOf already knows what to do with it; each caller passes its own seconds and share, so this row is the default and the name the log prints.
_descDoc: EVERY `desc` BELOW IS GENERATED, NOT WRITTEN. `js/skills.js` `describeSkill(skill, statuses)` builds each line out of that skill's own `mult`, `reach`, `arc`, `radius`, `range`, `splash`, `width`, `projectiles`, `spread`, `heal`, `status`, `mp` and `cooldown`, and out of the `statuses` row the skill names — so a description cannot promise something the numbers do not do. The text is stored here as well as generated so the screens that read this file directly (js/classbuild-ui.js, js/followers-ui.js, js/newgame.js) are right before any skill bar is built; `describeSkills(data)` runs at the top of `createSkillBar` and rewrites all forty anyway, so changing a number here changes the card even if nobody regenerated the file. Do not hand-edit a `desc`: change the number, or change `describeSkill`.
_doc: Farhold's skill bar (round 4). Emberveil's skills are written for a turn-based party fight ('adjacent2', 'row', 'per_source'), which does not translate to one person in real time, so these are its ideas rebuilt around a shape, a radius and a cooldown. Each class gets SIX, on keys 1-6, unlocked at the levels in `unlockAt` — so a new character has one button and earns the rest. `element` picks the spell effect from avatar-3d/js/spellfx.js. `projectiles` on a bolt fires that many at once in a fan `spread` radians wide — a multi shot that fires one arrow is not a multi shot. Shapes: melee (an arc in front), around (a ring centred on you), bolt (flies where you look), beam (a line), ground (lands where you are looking), dash (you move, everything on the way is hit), self (you), summon (a temporary companion).

power_strike.name: Precise Strike
power_strike.desc: Strikes everything in a 92° arc 3.4 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 190% weapon damage. A critical hit with this skill applies Marked (takes 15% more damage) for 4s. Ignores 40% of the target's armour. No mana cost, 4s cooldown.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: Strikes everything within 4.5 m of you for 143% weapon damage. Deals 12% more damage for each enemy hit past the first, up to 48%. 6 mana, 7s cooldown.

sunder.name: Rend Plate
sunder.desc: Strikes everything in an 80° arc 3.2 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 224% weapon damage. Marks targets with Rent for 8s: they take 15% more damage from every source and take 2 times the damage when a rune detonates on them. 8 mana, 9s cooldown.

shield_bash.name: Rim Strike
shield_bash.desc: Strikes everything in a 126° arc 2.8 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 151% weapon damage. Stuns targets for 1s. Each enemy hit is taunted to attack you for 3s. 6 mana, 6s cooldown.

whirlwind.name: Iron Gyre
whirlwind.desc: Spins 5 times, striking everything within 5.5 m of you for 131% weapon damage on every spin. Leaves the target Bleeding: a further 72% weapon damage over 6s. Pulls targets 0.5 m toward you. For 1.7s: -30% move speed. 14 mana, 12s cooldown.

charge.name: Lead the Charge

recast.say: dash 10 m back the way you came, with every follower

charge.desc: Strikes everything within 2.4 m of your path for 252% weapon damage. Leaves the target Weakened: the target deals 35% less damage for 7s. Dashes up to 12 m toward where you aim. Your next skill within 6s deals 30% more damage and also empowers your followers' next attack. Every follower within 15 m moves with you to where you land. 10 mana, 10s cooldown.

execute.name: Assassinate
execute.desc: Strikes everything in a 69° arc 3 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 396% weapon damage as shadow. A kill with this skill: the cooldown resets. Deals 100% more damage to targets below 30% health. 12 mana, 14s cooldown.

aimed_shot.name: Long Draw
aimed_shot.desc: Looses one shot out to 42 m for 205% weapon damage. Deals 4% more damage for every metre past 20 m, up to 60%. Ignores 50% of the target's armour. 4 mana, 5s cooldown.

multi_shot.name: Broadhead Fan
multi_shot.desc: Looses 5 shots in an 11° fan out to 34 m, each for 66% weapon damage. Splits into 2 shards on a Quarry target, each striking an enemy within 6 m for 50% of the damage. 10 mana, 8s cooldown.

pinning_shot.name: Silvered Pin
pinning_shot.desc: Looses 2 shots in a 5° fan out to 38 m, each for 81% weapon damage, splashing everything within 1.4 m of where a shot lands. Deals 50% more damage to undead. Also applies Rooted for 2s and Stripped for 6s. 8 mana, 6s cooldown.

rain_of_arrows.name: Arrow Storm
rain_of_arrows.desc: Falls on a spot up to 32 m away and strikes everything within 6.5 m of it 8 times over 4s, for 43% weapon damage each time. Each strike lands at a random point inside the area, preferring enemies. Deals 50% more damage to Quarry targets. 16 mana, 14s cooldown.

poison_dart.name: Poison Dart
poison_dart.desc: Looses one bolt out to 34 m for 119% weapon damage as poison, splashing everything within 1.5 m of where the bolt lands. Adds 1 Poisoned stack to each target hit, up to 3. 6 mana, 5s cooldown.

shadowstep.name: Umbral Step

recast.say: dash 10 m back the way you came

shadowstep.desc: Strikes the enemy you reach for 294% weapon damage as shadow. Dashes up to 14 m to land behind the target. An afterimage where you stood repeats the strike 0.4s later for 40% of the damage. 10 mana, 9s cooldown.

eviscerate.name: Gutting Strike
eviscerate.desc: Strikes everything in a 63° arc 2.8 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 136% weapon damage. Leaves the target Bleeding: a further 52% weapon damage over 6s. Deals 80% more damage to stunned targets. Deals 30% more damage from behind the target. 8 mana, 7s cooldown.

smoke.name: Shroud
smoke.desc: Places a zone 8 m across around you for 6s, giving allies inside Shrouded (takes 35% less damage) while they stay in it, applying Weakened (deals 20% less damage) to enemies inside while they stay in it. 12 mana, 20s cooldown.

firebolt.name: Firebolt
firebolt.desc: Looses one bolt out to 36 m for 150% weapon damage as fire, splashing everything within 2.6 m of where the bolt lands. Adds 1 Burning stack to each target hit, up to 5. 8 mana, 4s cooldown.

fire_wall.name: Burning Line
fire_wall.desc: Falls on a spot up to 30 m away striking everything within 1.4 m of that spot for 172% weapon damage as fire. Laid as a 10 m line across the spot you aim at, 2 m wide. Leaves a 1.6 m pool for 5s that deals 105% weapon damage as fire over 5s to anything standing in it. Adds 2 Burning stacks to each target hit, up to 5. 18 mana, 13s cooldown.

frost_nova.name: Rime Burst
frost_nova.desc: Strikes everything within 6 m of you for 168% weapon damage as ice. Knocks targets back 2 m. Adds 3 Frostbite stacks to each target hit, up to 5. 14 mana, 9s cooldown.

ice_lance.name: Rime Spear
ice_lance.desc: Fires a 1.8 m wide beam 26 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 186% weapon damage as ice. Deals 20% more damage per Frostbite stack on the target, up to 100%, and removes the Frostbite. 12 mana, 7s cooldown.

chain_bolt.name: Forked Bolt
chain_bolt.desc: Looses one bolt out to 40 m for 110% weapon damage as lightning, splashing everything within 1.2 m of where the bolt lands. Leaves the target Shocked: the target takes 30% more damage for 5s. Bounces to 4 more targets within 8 m, each bounce dealing 80% of the damage. 8 mana, 4s cooldown.

thunderclap.name: Thunder Ring
thunderclap.desc: Strikes everything within 7 m of you for 164% weapon damage as lightning. Leaves the target Shocked: the target takes 30% more damage for 5s. Places a zone 14 m across around you for 6s, an enemy that crosses its edge, in or out, takes 100% weapon damage, a 0.6s stun and Shocked (takes 30% more damage) for 5s. 18 mana, 12s cooldown.

storm_beam.name: Storm Beam
storm_beam.desc: Fires a 2.4 m wide beam 30 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 343% weapon damage as lightning. Leaves the target Shocked: the target takes 30% more damage for 5s. 20 mana, 11s cooldown.

shadow_lance.name: Shadow Lance
shadow_lance.desc: Looses one bolt out to 38 m for 205% weapon damage as shadow, splashing everything within 2 m of where the bolt lands. Each enemy hit heals the most-hurt ally for 25% of the damage dealt. 10 mana, 5s cooldown.

curse.name: Hex of Ruin
curse.desc: Looses one bolt out to 34 m for 180% weapon damage as shadow, splashing everything within 5 m of where the bolt lands. Leaves the target Cursed: the target takes 25% more damage and moves 15% slower for 8s. Also applies Weakened (deals 15% less damage) for 8s. 14 mana, 12s cooldown.

drain.name: Grave Draught
drain.desc: Fires a 1.6 m wide beam 22 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 224% weapon damage as shadow. Heals you for 12% of the damage dealt. Every follower heals 12% of its maximum health. 12 mana, 9s cooldown.

arcane_burst.name: Arcane Burst
arcane_burst.desc: Falls on a spot up to 34 m away striking everything within 5 m of that spot for 266% weapon damage as arcane. Leaves the target Cursed: the target takes 25% more damage and moves 15% slower for 8s. Deals 20% more damage for each different status on the target, up to 100%. 18 mana, 10s cooldown.

meteor.name: Fallstone
meteor.desc: Falls on a spot up to 36 m away striking everything within 8 m of that spot for 708% weapon damage as fire. Adds 3 Burning stacks to each target hit, up to 5. 30 mana, 22s cooldown.

mend.name: Mend
mend.desc: Heals you for 35% of your maximum health. Every follower heals 20% of its maximum health. Healing past your maximum becomes a barrier, up to 10% of maximum health. 18 mana, 14s cooldown.

renew.name: Greensap
renew.desc: Gives you Mending: heals 25% of your maximum health over 10s. Everything following you is mended with you. Changes with your shape or stance: Thornswell (Briarback), Shed Skin (Fenrunner) and Mycel Web (Sporecap). 14 mana, 16s cooldown.

warcry.name: War Cry
warcry.desc: Gives you Might: you deal 30% more damage for 12s. Enemies within 10 m attack you for 3s. Each enemy taunted adds 5% damage to the buff, up to 25%. 10 mana, 22s cooldown.

guard_stance.name: Sworn Guard
guard_stance.desc: For 8s: -20% move speed; take 50% less damage from the front. Links the follower nearest your aim to you for 8s: you take 40% of the damage dealt to it instead. 8 mana, 18s cooldown.

stoneskin.name: Runeskin
stoneskin.desc: For 6s: take 40% less damage; melee attackers take 15% of the hit back; every melee attacker that hits you takes 1 Rune stack. 14 mana, 24s cooldown.

quicken.name: Quicken
quicken.desc: Gives you Hastened: you attack 45% faster and move 30% faster for 10s. Everything following you gets the same. Casting this takes 2s off every other skill's cooldown. 16 mana, 26s cooldown.

rally.name: Rally
rally.desc: Gives you Rallied: you deal 20% more damage and take 15% less damage for 8s. Everything following you gets the same. Orders your followers to return to you for 3s. 18 mana, 30s cooldown.

consecrate.name: Blessed Earth
consecrate.desc: Strikes everything within 6.5 m of you for 274% weapon damage as holy. Places a zone 13 m across where you stand for 6s, striking 6 enemies within 6.5 m every 1s for 20% weapon damage, healing you and your followers inside 2% of maximum health every 1s. 20 mana, 16s cooldown.

raise_thrall.name: Raise Thrall

summon.name: Rotting Thrall whose blows leave Poisoned

raise_thrall.desc: Summons 1 Bone Thrall to fight beside you. Summons 1 thrall with 50% more health from a corpse within 12 m; it has 50% more health. 20 mana, 26s cooldown.

call_wolf.name: Call the Pack
call_wolf.desc: Summons 1 Grove Wolf to fight beside you. Changes with your shape or stance: Den Guard (Briarback), Running Pack (Fenrunner) and Puffball Brood (Sporecap). With the pack already called, casting this is a howl instead: the pack gets Hastened for 6s and 30% more damage. 18 mana, 26s cooldown.

call_spirit.name: Call a Spirit
call_spirit.desc: Summons 1 Spirit Bear to fight beside you. Orders your class companion to leap onto the target, the next attack dealing 50% more damage for 4s. With the pack already called, casting this is a howl instead: the pack gets Hastened for 4s and they draw every enemy within 4 m of you for 4s. 26 mana, 40s cooldown.

bind_imp.name: Bind a Fiend

summon.name: Bound Imp whose bolts leave Gnawed
Bound Imp whose bolts leave Burning

recast.say: swap places with the follower or enemy you aim at

bind_imp.desc: Summons 1 Bound Imp to fight beside you. Costs 10% of your maximum health, never taking you below 1 health. Summons 1 Bound Imp whose bolts leave Gnawed; its attacks apply Gnawed. 16 mana, 32s cooldown.

deploy_sentry.name: Deploy Sentry

summon.name: Flame Turret that sets what it hits Burning
Arc Turret that leaves what it hits Shocked

deploy_sentry.desc: Summons 1 Field Turret for 20s; it takes no follower slot. 20 mana, 30s cooldown.

flamethrower.name: Wyrm's Breath
flamethrower.desc: Breathes a stream that strikes everything in a 52° cone 7 m in front of you 10 times over 2.2s, for 44% weapon damage as fire each time. Leaves the target Burning: a further 23% weapon damage over 5s. Changes with your shape or stance: Frost Breath (Frost Temper) and Storm Breath (Storm Temper). Its element and status follow your Wyrm Temper. 18 mana, 10s cooldown.

ember_stride.name: Cinder Stride
ember_stride.desc: For 8s, every step leaves burning ground behind you, 3.6 m across, that lasts 2.5s and strikes whatever stands in it for 57% weapon damage as fire every 0.75s. Leaves a 3 m pool for 4s that deals 175% weapon damage as fire over 4s to anything standing in it. For 8s: +20% move speed. 16 mana, 20s cooldown.

storm_orbs.name: Storm Orbs

recast.say: release the orbs as an 8 m ring of lightning for 120% weapon damage

storm_orbs.desc: For 12s, 3 orbs circle you in a fight; each one strikes the nearest enemy within 8 m every 1.2s for 39% weapon damage as lightning and leaves it Shocked. Leaves a 3 m pool for 4s that deals 175% weapon damage as lightning over 4s to anything standing in it, applying Shocked (takes 30% more damage) for 5s. 22 mana, 24s cooldown.

blizzard.name: Whiteout
blizzard.desc: Falls on a spot up to 30 m away and strikes everything within 5.5 m of it 6 times over 3s, for 63% weapon damage as ice each time. Adds 1 Frostbite stack to each target hit, up to 5. 24 mana, 14s cooldown.

toxic_cloud.name: Plague Cloud
toxic_cloud.desc: Falls on a spot up to 26 m away and strikes everything within 5 m of it 8 times over 4.8s, for 45% weapon damage as poison each time. Leaves the target Poisoned: a further 25% weapon damage over 8s. A kill with this skill: it leaves a 2 m cloud for 3s. Also applies Bleeding for 6s. 20 mana, 14s cooldown.

judgement.name: Falling Light
judgement.desc: Falls on a spot up to 28 m away, 0.7s after you cast, striking everything within 3.5 m of that spot for 432% weapon damage as holy. Places a zone 7 m across where you aim for 1s, healing you and your followers inside 10% of maximum health every 1s. Deals 50% more damage to Lit targets. 22 mana, 14s cooldown.

void_rift.name: Void Rift

recast.say: dash up to 20 m toward where you aim

void_rift.desc: Falls on a spot up to 26 m away and strikes everything within 5 m of it 4 times over 2s, for 88% weapon damage as shadow each time. Every pulse drags everything 2.5 m toward the middle. Copies Gnawed, Burning, Poisoned, Bleeding and Cursed from the target to up to 3 enemies within 5 m. 24 mana, 16s cooldown.

breaching_shove.name: Breaching Shove
breaching_shove.desc: Strikes everything in an 80° arc 3 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 136% weapon damage. Knocks targets back 4 m and stuns them for 0.6s. 6 mana, 7s cooldown.

iron_resolve.name: Iron Resolve
iron_resolve.desc: For 10s: take 6% less damage for each enemy within 6 m, up to 36%; every 4th hit you take releases a 4 m shockwave for 80% weapon damage. 10 mana, 30s cooldown.

groundbreaker.name: Groundbreaker
groundbreaker.desc: Fires a 2.4 m wide beam 18 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 593% weapon damage. Stuns targets for 1.2s. Leaves a 1.4 m patch for 5s all along the line that slows anything standing in it 60%. Deals 50% more damage to stunned targets. 22 mana, 20s cooldown.

thornlash.name: Thornlash
thornlash.desc: Looses one bolt out to 30 m for 140% weapon damage as nature. Each enemy hit heals your nearest follower 3% of maximum health. Also applies Rooted for 0.6s, at most once per target every 6s. Changes with your shape or stance: Bramble Gore (Briarback), Venom Lunge (Fenrunner) and Spore Lob (Sporecap). 5 mana, 3s cooldown.

briarback_shape.name: Briarback Shape
briarback_shape.desc: Press again to return to your own body. While in Briarback shape: +60% armour, +30% maximum health, melee attackers take 15% of the hit back and your basic attack becomes a strike 2.8 m in front of you for 100% weapon damage. Entering it: enemies within 6 m attack you for 3s. 8 mana, 1.5s cooldown.

fenrunner_shape.name: Fenrunner Shape
fenrunner_shape.desc: Press again to return to your own body. While in Fenrunner shape: -30% armour, +35% move speed, +25% attack speed, your basic attack becomes 2 quick strikes 2.2 m in front of you for 55% weapon damage each, a strike from behind applies Poisoned and entering it, enemies further than 10 m lose track of you. 8 mana, 1.5s cooldown.

sporecap_shape.name: Sporecap Shape
sporecap_shape.desc: Lasts 15s; casting it again ends it early. While in Sporecap shape: -40% move speed, +40% healing done, immune to poison, your basic attack becomes a lobbed strike out to 14 m that splashes 1.5 m for 70% weapon damage that applies Poisoned and an ally inside the splash heals 2% of maximum health. Entering it: applies Poisoned for 8s to everything within 6 m of you and heals you and your followers within it 10% of maximum health. Leaving it: strikes everything within 8 m of you for 150% weapon damage as poison, applies Poisoned for 8s and heals you and your followers within it 15% of maximum health. 30 mana, 50s cooldown.

duelist_stance.name: Duelist's Stance
duelist_stance.desc: Steps to the next of 2: Open stance and Closed stance. Open stance: -15% armour, +15% attack speed and +20% damage. Closed stance: +50% armour and -10% damage. No mana cost, 1.5s cooldown.

wyrm_temper.name: Wyrm Temper
wyrm_temper.desc: Steps to the next of 3: Fire Temper, Frost Temper and Storm Temper. Fire Temper: +15% damage and skills that follow the temper deal fire and apply Burning. Leaving it: strikes everything within 4 m of you for 60% weapon damage as fire and applies Burning for 5s. Frost Temper: +25% armour and skills that follow the temper deal ice and apply Chilled. Leaving it: strikes everything within 4 m of you for 60% weapon damage as ice and applies Chilled (moves 45% slower) for 4s. Storm Temper: +15% attack speed and skills that follow the temper deal lightning and apply Shocked. Leaving it: strikes everything within 4 m of you for 60% weapon damage as lightning and applies Shocked (takes 30% more damage) for 5s. No mana cost, 2s cooldown.

ballad_of_valour.name: Ballad of Valour
ballad_of_valour.desc: Plays until you press it again or play another song. While in Ballad of Valour: within 10 m of you allies get Valour (attacks 25% faster and moves 10% faster). Switching away plays its Finale: for 4s, your followers: +40% damage. 8 mana, 2s cooldown.

song_of_ruin.name: Song of Ruin
song_of_ruin.desc: Plays until you press it again or play another song. While in Song of Ruin: within 10 m of you enemies get Cursed (takes 12% more damage and deals 10% less damage). Switching away plays its Finale: strikes everything within 10 m of you for 150% weapon damage as shadow; also applies Weakened (deals 35% less damage) for 5s. 8 mana, 2s cooldown.

air_of_mending.name: Air of Mending
air_of_mending.desc: Plays until you press it again or play another song. While in Air of Mending: within 10 m of you allies heal 2% of maximum health a second. Switching away plays its Finale: heals you and your followers within it 15% of maximum health; removes 1 harmful status from you and every follower. 8 mana, 2s cooldown.

sunlance.name: Sunlance
sunlance.desc: Fires a 1.4 m wide beam 24 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 174% weapon damage as holy. Each enemy hit heals you and your followers 2% of maximum health. Marks targets with Lit for 3s: they take 10% more damage from you. 10 mana, 6s cooldown.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.desc: Lands on a spot up to 20 m away. Places a zone 10 m across where you aim for 6s, healing you and your followers inside 3% of maximum health every 1s, pushing enemies inside 2 m outward every second. 26 mana, 24s cooldown.

guardian_light.name: Guardian Light
guardian_light.desc: Summons 1 Guardian Light for 20s; it takes no follower slot; it heals the most-hurt of you and your followers 6% every 2s. 24 mana, 30s cooldown.

raise_the_fallen.name: Raise the Fallen
raise_the_fallen.desc: Gives you Rallied: you deal 20% more damage and take 15% less damage for 8s. Everything following you gets the same. Every follower heals 30% of its maximum health. Revives every fallen follower at once at 50% health. 30 mana, 40s cooldown.

dawn_prayer.name: Prayer of Dawn
dawn_prayer.desc: Strikes everything within 10 m of you for 180% weapon damage as holy. Heals you for 20% of your maximum health. Every follower heals 20% of its maximum health. 16 mana, 12s cooldown.

mark_the_killer.name: Mark the Killer
mark_the_killer.desc: Looses one bolt out to 34 m for 158% weapon damage as shadow. Marks targets with Killer for 8s: they take 20% more damage from you. 9 mana, 8s cooldown.

vigil.name: Vigil
vigil.desc: For 12s, you and every follower: the first killing blow leaves you at 1 health and ends it with a 6 m blast for 150% weapon damage. 24 mana, 45s cooldown.

dread_hymn.name: Dread Hymn
dread_hymn.desc: Strikes everything within 8 m of you for 233% weapon damage as shadow. Also applies Feared for 3s. For 4s, your followers: +20% damage. 14 mana, 18s cooldown.

twinlight.name: Twinlight
twinlight.desc: Spins 6 times, striking everything within 14 m of you for 310% weapon damage as shadow on every spin. Each enemy hit heals the most-hurt ally for 25% of the damage dealt. Places a zone 28 m across around you for 6s, healing you and your followers inside 3% of maximum health every 1s. 36 mana, 40s cooldown.

omen_bolt.name: Omen Bolt
omen_bolt.desc: Looses one bolt out to 32 m for 120% weapon damage as arcane. Marks targets with Omen for 6s. Also applies Weakened (deals 25% less damage) for 3s. 5 mana, 3s cooldown.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.desc: You and every follower get a ward for 15s that completely negates the first hit worth more than 10% of maximum health. 14 mana, 16s cooldown.

prophecy.name: Prophecy
prophecy.desc: Falls on a spot up to 30 m away, 2.5s after you cast, striking everything within 6 m of that spot for 270% weapon damage as arcane. Places a zone 12 m across on the aimed enemy, following it for 2.5s, applying Chilled (moves 30% slower) to enemies inside while they stay in it. Deals 100% more damage to Omen targets. 16 mana, 14s cooldown.

fate_thread.name: Thread of Fate
fate_thread.desc: Gives you Mending: heals 25% of your maximum health over 10s. Everything following you is mended with you. Links the follower nearest your aim to you for 8s: you take 50% of the damage dealt to it instead. 12 mana, 18s cooldown.

turn_aside.name: Turn Aside
turn_aside.desc: Strikes everything within 6 m of you for 180% weapon damage as arcane. Knocks targets back 3 m interrupting the attack they were winding up. 12 mana, 12s cooldown.

last_prophecy.name: The Last Prophecy
last_prophecy.desc: Places a zone 40 m across around you for 8s, applying Weakened (deals 25% less damage) to enemies inside while they stay in it. For 8s, your followers: +40% damage; when it ends strikes everything within 12 m of you for 300% weapon damage as arcane. 36 mana, 60s cooldown.

spirit_bolt.name: Spirit Bolt
spirit_bolt.desc: Looses one bolt out to 32 m for 120% weapon damage as lightning. Bounces to 2 more targets within 8 m, each bounce dealing 70% of the damage. Each enemy hit heals you and your followers 2% of maximum health. 5 mana, 3s cooldown.

mending_post.name: Mending Post
mending_post.desc: Lands on a spot up to 12 m away. Places a post where you aim for 12s, healing you and your followers within 8 m of it 2% of maximum health every 1s, the post has 30% of your maximum health and can be broken, at most 2 stand at once. 16 mana, 18s cooldown.

storm_post.name: Storm Post
storm_post.desc: Lands on a spot up to 16 m away. Places a post where you aim for 10s, striking 2 enemies within 10 m every 1s for 25% weapon damage, the post has 30% of your maximum health and can be broken. 18 mana, 16s cooldown.

warding_spirits.name: Warding Spirits
warding_spirits.desc: You and every follower get a ward for 12s that completely negates 3 hits, each one of up to 8% of maximum health. 18 mana, 24s cooldown.

great_post.name: The Great Post
great_post.desc: Lands on a spot up to 16 m away. Places a post where you aim for 15s, striking 3 enemies within 12 m every 1.5s for 40% weapon damage, healing you and your followers within 12 m of it 2% of maximum health every 1.5s, the post has 50% of your maximum health and can be broken, each Spirit Bolt hit within 12 m of the post rings the post for 60% weapon damage. 36 mana, 50s cooldown.

discord_note.name: Discord Note
discord_note.desc: Looses one bolt out to 30 m for 130% weapon damage as arcane, splashing everything within 1.6 m of where the bolt lands. Bounces to 1 more target within 8 m, each bounce dealing 60% of the damage. Changes with your shape or stance: Marching Note (Ballad of Valour), Ruinous Note (Song of Ruin) and Mending Note (Air of Mending). 5 mana, 3s cooldown.

quickstep_jig.name: Quickstep Jig
quickstep_jig.desc: Carries you 10 m forward, striking everything within 2 m of your path for 237% weapon damage. Also applies Weakened (deals 20% less damage) for 3s. Changes with your shape or stance: Valiant Step (Ballad of Valour), Ruinous Step (Song of Ruin) and Mending Step (Air of Mending). 8 mana, 10s cooldown.

grand_finale.name: Grand Finale
grand_finale.desc: Strikes everything within 12 m of you for 986% weapon damage as arcane. Deals 25% more damage for each follower alive, up to 50%. 30 mana, 30s cooldown.

sucker_punch.name: Sucker Punch
sucker_punch.desc: Strikes everything in a 57° arc 2.6 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 178% weapon damage. Stuns targets for 1.6s. Deals 50% more damage from behind the target. 6 mana, 10s cooldown.

grave_mark.name: Grave Mark
grave_mark.desc: Looses one bolt out to 30 m for 365% weapon damage as shadow. Marks targets with Grave Marked for 10s: they take 25% more damage from you and take 30% of the damage dealt to them during the mark again when it ends. 12 mana, 20s cooldown.

slip_away.name: Slip Away

recast.say: dash 8 m back the way you are facing

slip_away.desc: Your next skill within 6s counts as from behind. Summons a decoy, each with 36% of your maximum health, that does not move or attack and draws every enemy near it for 4s; it takes no follower slot. 10 mana, 22s cooldown.

knife_storm.name: Knife Storm
knife_storm.desc: Strikes 8 times over 2.8s, each strike at one spot within 7 m of you, 2.4 m across, for 93% weapon damage each. Each strike lands at a random point inside the area, preferring enemies. 22 mana, 22s cooldown.

shade_cut.name: Shade Cut

recast.say: step 5 m back to where your afterimage stood

shade_cut.desc: Strikes everything in a 92° arc 2.8 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 100% weapon damage as shadow. An afterimage where you stood repeats the strike 0.5s later for 50% of the damage. 3 mana, 3s cooldown.

cutting_waltz.name: Cutting Waltz
cutting_waltz.desc: Strikes 5 times over 1.3s, each strike at one spot within 8 m of you, 2.4 m across, for 81% weapon damage as shadow each. Each strike lands at a random point inside the area, preferring enemies. An afterimage where you end up repeats the strike 0.6s later for 40% of the damage. 14 mana, 14s cooldown.

host_of_shades.name: Host of Shades

recast.say: swap places with the shade or enemy you aim at

host_of_shades.desc: Summons 3 shades for 10s; it takes no follower slot. Your summoned copies repeat every skill you cast from where they stand, for 40% of the damage. 34 mana, 50s cooldown.

flourish.name: Flourish
flourish.desc: Strikes everything in a 92° arc 3 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 135% weapon damage. Gains 1 Flair when you cast it, 2 if your previous skill was a different one. 3 mana, 3s cooldown.

daring_leap.name: Daring Leap

recast.say: spring 5 m back off the target

daring_leap.desc: Strikes the enemy you reach for 196% weapon damage. Leaps up to 10 m to land behind the target, striking nothing on the way. On landing, strikes everything within 2.5 m for 40% weapon damage. Gains 1 Flair when you cast it. Your next skill within 3s counts as from behind. 6 mana, 9s cooldown.

mocking_parry.name: Mocking Parry
mocking_parry.desc: For 1.5s, the next melee hit on you is negated; the attacker is taunted for 3s and you gain 2 Flair. 4 mana, 10s cooldown.

pinning_thrust.name: Pinning Thrust

recast.say: vault 6 m over the pinned body to its back

pinning_thrust.desc: Fires a 1 m wide beam 6 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 132% weapon damage. Also applies Rooted for 2s. Spends 1 Flair: 50% more damage for each point spent if you have it. 6 mana, 8s cooldown.

matadors_turn.name: Matador's Turn
matadors_turn.desc: Strikes everything within 4 m of you for 213% weapon damage. Marks targets with Turned About for 3s: they take every hit as if it came from behind. Also applies Weakened (deals 20% less damage) for 3s. Gains 1 Flair for each enemy hit. 10 mana, 12s cooldown.

grandeur.name: Grandeur
grandeur.desc: Strikes everything in an 115° arc 4 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 182% weapon damage. Spends all your Flair: 75% more damage for each point spent. Spending 5 or more: becomes a ring 6 m around you; is a certain critical hit. 12 mana, 20s cooldown.

open_palm.name: Open Palm
open_palm.desc: Strikes everything in an 80° arc 2.8 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 120% weapon damage. Knocks targets back 2 m. Gains 1 Poise when you cast it. 2 mana, 3s cooldown.

wind_step.name: Wind Step

recast.say: spring 5 m back

wind_step.desc: Strikes the enemy you reach for 161% weapon damage. Dashes up to 10 m to the first enemy in the line. Gains 1 Poise when you cast it. Your next skill within 3s is a certain critical hit. 5 mana, 7s cooldown.

sweeping_heel.name: Sweeping Heel
sweeping_heel.desc: Strikes everything within 3.5 m of you for 178% weapon damage. Stuns targets for 1.2s. Marks targets with Downed for 3s: they take 20% more damage from you. 6 mana, 10s cooldown.

inner_stillness.name: Inner Stillness
inner_stillness.desc: Heals you for 6% of your maximum health. Gains 1 Poise when you cast it. Channels for up to 3s, striking every 1s; moving ends the channel, and pressing the key again ends it early. For 1.2s, the next 2 melee hits on you are reduced by 50%; you gain 1 Poise. No mana cost, 22s cooldown.

mountain_fist.name: Mountain Fist

recast.say: leap 10 m down the line and land in a 3 m ring for 60% weapon damage

mountain_fist.desc: Fires a 1.6 m wide beam 10 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 426% weapon damage. Stuns targets for 1.5s. Gains 2 Poise when you cast it. 10 mana, 12s cooldown.

ninefold_staff.name: Ninefold Staff
ninefold_staff.desc: Spins 3 times, striking everything within 3.5 m of you for 122% weapon damage on every spin. Each strike reaches 1.2 m further than the last. Spends all your Poise: 33% more damage for each point spent. 16 mana, 22s cooldown.

lucky_strike.name: Lucky Strike
lucky_strike.desc: Strikes everything in an 80° arc 3 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 150% weapon damage. Each hit applies one random status: Burning, Poisoned, Bleeding, Chilled, Shocked, Weakened and Snared. 3 mana, 4s cooldown.

junk_toss.name: Junk Toss
junk_toss.desc: Looses one shot out to 26 m for 162% weapon damage. Each cast deals a random element: physical, fire and poison. 6 mana, 6s cooldown.

scrounge.name: Scrounge
scrounge.desc: Heals you for 8% of your maximum health. For 15s: +15% move speed; each hit you take restores 2 mana. 6 mana, 20s cooldown.

caltrop_scatter.name: Caltrop Scatter

recast.say: dash 6 m back from where you stand

caltrop_scatter.desc: Falls on a spot up to 16 m away striking everything within 4 m of that spot for 164% weapon damage. Sets a trap where you aim that arms after 0.5s, lasts 20s and fires on the first enemy within 2 m, dealing 80% weapon damage and applying Bleeding for 6s, at most 4 stand at once. Also applies Chilled (moves 50% slower) for 3s. 8 mana, 12s cooldown.

pitch_bomb.name: Rag-and-Pitch Bomb
pitch_bomb.desc: Falls on a spot up to 22 m away, 1s after you cast, striking everything within 4 m of that spot for 288% weapon damage as fire. Leaves a 3 m pool for 4s that deals 75% weapon damage over 4s to anything standing in it. Each cast deals a random element: fire, poison, lightning and ice. 12 mana, 14s cooldown.

big_score.name: Big Score
big_score.desc: Strikes everything in an 80° arc 3 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 244% weapon damage. A kill with this skill: you find 25 gold. Deals between 20% and 500% of the listed damage, rolled each cast. 16 mana, 22s cooldown.

silver_edge.name: Silver Edge
silver_edge.desc: Strikes everything in an 80° arc 3 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 110% weapon damage. Deals 60% more damage to casters and archers. Deals 50% more damage to undead. Removes 1 harmful status from you. 3 mana, 4s cooldown.

null_circle.name: Null Circle
null_circle.desc: Falls on a spot up to 16 m away striking everything within 6 m of that spot for 212% weapon damage as holy. Places a zone 12 m across where you aim for 8s, applying Silenced to enemies inside while they stay in it, enemy ranged hits on anyone within 6 m of its middle are stopped. 14 mana, 18s cooldown.

writ_of_guilt.name: Writ of Guilt
writ_of_guilt.desc: Looses one bolt out to 40 m for 252% weapon damage as holy. Marks targets with Guilty for 10s: they take 25% more damage from every source. Orders your followers to attack the target for 10s. 10 mana, 14s cooldown.

iron_net.name: Iron Net

recast.say: dash 6 m back
pull everything within 8 m of you 5 m closer

iron_net.desc: Looses one shot out to 20 m for 164% weapon damage, splashing everything within 4 m of where the shot lands. Also applies Rooted for 3s and Silenced for 3s. 8 mana, 12s cooldown.

purging_rite.name: Rite of Purging
purging_rite.desc: Strikes everything within 12 m of you for 801% weapon damage as holy. Deals 50% more damage to champions, rares and bosses. Also applies Stripped for 8s. Removes 2 harmful statuses from you and every follower. 26 mana, 30s cooldown.

frost_shard.name: Frost Shard
frost_shard.desc: Looses one bolt out to 34 m for 110% weapon damage as ice, splashing everything within 1.4 m of where the bolt lands. Adds 1 Frostbite stack to each target hit, up to 5. 5 mana, 2.5s cooldown.

spellrush.name: Spellrush
spellrush.desc: Your next 3 skills within 10s deal 60% more damage and cost no mana. 20 mana, 30s cooldown.

stillfrost.name: Stillfrost
stillfrost.desc: Falls on a spot up to 30 m away, 1.5s after you cast, striking everything within 7 m of that spot for 924% weapon damage as ice. Deals 20% more damage per Frostbite stack on the target, up to 100%, and removes the Frostbite. Adds 5 Frostbite stacks to each target hit, up to 5. 34 mana, 30s cooldown.

stoke_familiar.name: Stoke the Familiar
stoke_familiar.desc: For 10s, your followers: +50% damage; take 25% less damage. Orders your class companion to attack the target for 10s; meanwhile their attacks apply Burning. Revives every fallen follower at once at 60% health. 14 mana, 20s cooldown.

flashover.name: Flashover
flashover.desc: Falls on a spot up to 30 m away striking everything within 6 m of that spot for 180% weapon damage as fire. Deals 60% of the remaining Burning damage on each target at once, leaving 1 stack. 16 mana, 12s cooldown.

bolt_step.name: Bolt Step

recast.say: dash 12 m back the way you came, striking for 50% weapon damage

bolt_step.desc: Carries you 12 m forward, striking everything within 2 m of your path for 222% weapon damage as lightning. Leaves the target Shocked: the target takes 30% more damage for 5s. For 0.8s: enemies cannot target you. 10 mana, 10s cooldown.

tempest_eye.name: Eye of the Tempest
tempest_eye.desc: Falls on a spot up to 30 m away and strikes everything within 9 m of it 12 times over 6s, for 105% weapon damage as lightning each time. Leaves the target Shocked: the target takes 30% more damage for 5s. Each strike lands at a random point inside the area, preferring enemies. 34 mana, 30s cooldown.

wild_bolt.name: Wild Bolt
wild_bolt.desc: Looses one bolt out to 34 m for 130% weapon damage as arcane, splashing everything within 1.2 m of where the bolt lands. Each cast deals a random element: fire, ice, lightning, shadow, poison and arcane. 5 mana, 3s cooldown.

mana_rend.name: Mana Rend
mana_rend.desc: Fires a 1.8 m wide beam 22 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 237% weapon damage as arcane. Each enemy hit restores 8 mana. Deals 60% more damage to casters and archers. Deals 60% more damage to champions, rares and bosses. Also applies Silenced for 2s. No mana cost, 10s cooldown.

overchannel.name: Overchannel
overchannel.desc: For 8s: +60% damage; every skill cast costs 3% of your maximum health. No mana cost, 30s cooldown.

transmute.name: Transmute
transmute.desc: Looses one bolt out to 26 m without dealing damage. A non-boss target becomes a small harmless creature for 5s: it deals no damage and moves 50% slower, and damage after the first 1s turns it back. 14 mana, 18s cooldown.

sixfold_ruin.name: Sixfold Ruin
sixfold_ruin.desc: Falls on a spot up to 30 m away and strikes everything within 9 m of it 6 times over 2.1s, for 238% weapon damage as arcane each time. The strikes take each of 6 forms in turn and one strike each of fire, ice, lightning, shadow, poison and arcane. 38 mana, 34s cooldown.

second_hand.name: Second Hand
second_hand.desc: Looses one bolt out to 32 m for 110% weapon damage as arcane, splashing everything within 1 m of where the bolt lands. Adds 1 Lagging stack to each target hit, up to 4. Each enemy hit takes 0.2s off every other skill's cooldown. 4 mana, 2.5s cooldown.

entropy_field.name: Entropy Field
entropy_field.desc: Falls on a spot up to 30 m away and strikes everything within 5.5 m of it 8 times over 6s, for 40% weapon damage as arcane each time. Adds 1 Lagging stack to each target hit, up to 4. Deals 15% more damage for each different status on the target, up to 60%. 18 mana, 14s cooldown.

rewind.name: Rewind
rewind.desc: Casting this takes 3s off every other skill's cooldown. Returns your position and health (only upward) to where they were 4s ago. 16 mana, 30s cooldown.

stasis_lock.name: Stasis Lock
stasis_lock.desc: Looses one bolt out to 28 m without dealing damage. A non-boss target is held still and cannot be hurt for 4s; the damage dealt to it meanwhile lands at once, 150% of it, when it thaws. A boss is slowed 60% instead. 14 mana, 16s cooldown.

stop_the_clock.name: Stop the Clock
stop_the_clock.desc: Strikes everything within 25 m of you without dealing damage. For 4s: your cooldowns run 4 times as fast. A non-boss target is held still and cannot be hurt for 4s; the damage dealt to it meanwhile lands at once, 125% of it, when it thaws. A boss is slowed 60% instead. 40 mana, 60s cooldown.

arcane_jolt.name: Arcane Jolt
arcane_jolt.desc: Looses one bolt out to 34 m for 70% weapon damage as arcane. Deals 150% more damage to sleeping targets, and removes the sleeping. 4 mana, 2.5s cooldown.

drowse.name: Drowse
drowse.desc: Lands on a spot up to 30 m away, affecting everything within 5 m of it. Also applies Asleep for 6s. 14 mana, 14s cooldown.

beguile.name: Beguile

recast.say: blast the spot you aim at for 200% weapon damage within 3 m

beguile.desc: Looses one bolt out to 26 m without dealing damage. A non-boss target fights its own side for 10s, following you; when it ends the target is Weakened for 3s. Champions and rares turn for half as long; a boss is slowed 60% instead. 18 mana, 24s cooldown.

lethargy.name: Lethargy
lethargy.desc: Lands on a spot up to 26 m away. Places a zone 12 m across where you aim for 8s, applying Lethargic (moves 50% slower) to enemies inside while they stay in it. 14 mana, 16s cooldown.

phantasm.name: Phantasm

recast.say: swap places with the aimed enemy (not a boss) up to 30 m away

phantasm.desc: Summons a decoy, each with 30% of your maximum health, that does not move or attack and draws every enemy near it for 8s; whatever strikes it gets Asleep for 2s; it takes no follower slot. 14 mana, 22s cooldown.

enthrall.name: Grand Enthrallment
enthrall.desc: Strikes everything within 12 m of you without dealing damage. A non-boss target fights its own side for 6s; when it ends the target is Weakened for 4s. Champions and rares turn for half as long; a boss is slowed 60% instead. 40 mana, 60s cooldown.

hunters_snare.name: Hunter's Snare
hunters_snare.desc: Falls on a spot up to 20 m away striking everything within 2.5 m of that spot for 207% weapon damage as nature. Sets a trap where you aim that arms after 1s, lasts 30s and fires on the first enemy within 2 m, dealing 80% weapon damage and applying Rooted for 2s, at most 2 stand at once. 8 mana, 10s cooldown.

quarry_call.name: Call the Quarry
quarry_call.desc: Looses one shot out to 40 m for 252% weapon damage. Marks targets with Quarry for 12s: they take 20% more damage from every source. Orders your followers to leap onto the target, the next attack dealing 50% more damage for 6s. 10 mana, 14s cooldown.

trackers_leap.name: Tracker's Leap
trackers_leap.desc: Strikes everything within 2.5 m of your path for 213% weapon damage. Dashes up to 9 m backward, away from where you aim. Your next skill within 3s deals 50% more damage. 8 mana, 12s cooldown.

hex_bolt.name: Brand Bolt
hex_bolt.desc: Looses one bolt out to 40 m for 135% weapon damage as shadow. Marks targets with Brand for 8s: they take 15% more damage from you. Deals 50% more damage to fiends and aberrations. Gains 1 Grudge when you are hit. 4 mana, 3.5s cooldown.

tumbling_shot.name: Tumbling Shot
tumbling_shot.desc: Strikes everything within 2 m of your path for 158% weapon damage. Knocks targets back 2 m. Dashes up to 7 m backward, away from where you aim. Gains 1 Grudge when you cast it. 6 mana, 8s cooldown.

chain_hook.name: Chain Hook
chain_hook.desc: Fires a 1.2 m wide beam 18 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 222% weapon damage. Stuns targets for 0.8s. Pulls targets 12 m toward you. Gains 1 Grudge for each enemy hit. 8 mana, 10s cooldown.

unleash_hound.name: Unleash the Hound
unleash_hound.desc: Gains 2 Grudge when you cast it. Orders your followers to leap onto the target, the next attack dealing 50% more damage for 8s. Revives every fallen follower at once at 50% health. 10 mana, 18s cooldown.

grudge_bolt.name: Settle the Grudge
grudge_bolt.desc: Looses one bolt out to 40 m for 70% weapon damage as shadow. Spends all your Grudge: 35% more damage for each point spent. Spending 5 or more: passes through 9 more targets; stuns targets for 1s. 8 mana, 6s cooldown.

night_hunt.name: Night Hunt
night_hunt.desc: Gains 3 Grudge when you cast it. Casting this takes 6s off Settle the Grudge's cooldown. For 12s your attacks apply Brand. For 12s: +15% move speed. 30 mana, 45s cooldown.

clockwork_bolt.name: Clockwork Bolt
clockwork_bolt.desc: Looses one shot out to 38 m for 110% weapon damage. Goes off again 1.2s later for 40% of the damage. Marks targets with Stuck for 4s: they take 10% more damage from every source. Orders your class companion to attack the target for 3s. 4 mana, 3s cooldown.

flask_grenade.name: Flask Grenade
flask_grenade.desc: Falls on a spot up to 24 m away striking everything within 3.5 m of that spot for 186% weapon damage as fire. Leaves the target Burning: a further 39% weapon damage over 5s. Each cast takes the next element in turn: fire, ice and poison. 8 mana, 7s cooldown.

pocket_watch.name: Pocket Watch
pocket_watch.desc: Heals you for 25% of your maximum health. You get a ward for 6s that completely negates the first hit worth more than 15% of maximum health. 14 mana, 22s cooldown.

grapple_line.name: Grapple Line
grapple_line.desc: Strikes everything within 1.5 m of your path, and the enemy you reach, for 207% weapon damage. Stuns targets for 0.5s. Dashes up to 18 m out on a line and pulls you to whatever the line hits first. 6 mana, 10s cooldown.

spring_battery.name: Spring Battery
spring_battery.desc: For 10s, you and every follower: +40% attack speed; skills cost no mana; when it ends for 3s: -20% move speed. 30 mana, 40s cooldown.

exploit_gap.name: Exploit the Gap
exploit_gap.desc: Strikes everything in an 80° arc 3 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 150% weapon damage. Marks targets with Flanked for 4s: they take 15% more damage from every source. Deals 40% more damage to an enemy that is attacking someone other than you. 4 mana, 4s cooldown.

reposition.name: Reposition
reposition.desc: Strikes everything within 1.5 m of your path for 207% weapon damage as arcane. Dashes up to 20 m and swaps places with the aimed follower or enemy (not a boss). A follower swapped with gets a barrier of 20% of maximum health. An enemy swapped with gets Weakened (deals 25% less damage) for 2s. 6 mana, 10s cooldown.

seize_initiative.name: Seize the Initiative
seize_initiative.desc: Casting this takes 30s off every follower ability's cooldowns. For 3s: your cooldowns run 2 times as fast. 20 mana, 30s cooldown.

battle_plan.name: Battle Plan
battle_plan.desc: Places a zone 16 m across around you for 10s, striking the nearest enemy within 8 m every 2s for 80% weapon damage, giving allies inside Hastened (attacks 30% faster and moves 15% faster) while they stay in it, applying Marked (takes 25% more damage and moves 30% slower) to enemies inside while they stay in it. Orders your followers to attack the target for 10s. 30 mana, 40s cooldown.

marrow_lance.name: Marrow Lance
marrow_lance.desc: Looses one bolt out to 34 m for 120% weapon damage as shadow. A kill with this skill: it leaves a corpse worth 2. 6 mana, 3s cooldown.

corpse_pyre.name: Corpse Pyre
corpse_pyre.desc: Falls on a spot up to 26 m away striking everything within 4 m of that spot for 178% weapon damage as shadow. Summons 5 burning corpses for 0.8s, one for each corpse within 10 m of where you aim, up to 5; each rises where its corpse lies; it takes no follower slot; when it ends it bursts for 100% weapon damage within 4 m. 14 mana, 10s cooldown.

buried_march.name: March of the Buried

summon.name: Buried Thrall, plus 1 for each corpse within 20 m (up to 8 in all),
Bone Archer, plus 1 for each corpse within 20 m (up to 8 in all),

buried_march.desc: Summons 1 Buried Thrall, plus 1 for each corpse within 20 m (up to 8 in all), for 18s, one for each corpse within 20 m of where you aim plus 1, up to 8; each rises where its corpse lies; it takes no follower slot. 40 mana, 60s cooldown.

gnawing_dark.name: Gnawing Dark
gnawing_dark.desc: Looses one bolt out to 34 m for 90% weapon damage as shadow. Leaves the target Gnawed: a further 63% weapon damage over 8s. 6 mana, 3s cooldown.

soul_pact.name: Soul Pact
soul_pact.desc: Costs 20% of your maximum health, never taking you below 1 health. For 10s: the statuses you apply tick 2 times as fast. No mana cost, 30s cooldown.

abyss_gate.name: Abyss Gate
abyss_gate.desc: Falls on a spot up to 26 m away striking everything within 4 m of that spot for 931% weapon damage as shadow. Places a post where you aim for 10s, striking a random enemy within 20 m every 0.8s for 20% weapon damage and applying Gnawed for 8s. Costs 10% of your maximum health, never taking you below 1 health. 26 mana, 40s cooldown.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: For 1.2s, the next melee hit on you is negated; each is answered with a strike for 250% weapon damage that stuns for 0.8s. Unused, 50% of the cooldown comes back. 4 mana, 8s cooldown.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.desc: Strikes everything within 1.6 m of your path, and the enemy you reach, for 252% weapon damage. Dashes up to 8 m to the first enemy in the line. Changes with your shape or stance: Long Lunge (Open stance) and Shield Lunge (Closed stance). 8 mana, 9s cooldown.

sweeping_guard.name: Sweeping Guard
sweeping_guard.desc: Strikes everything in a 178° arc 3.6 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 213% weapon damage. Marks targets with Riposted for 5s: they take 10% more damage from you. For 1.5s, the next 5 melee hits on you are reduced by 60% (from the front); the next cast of this skill deals 10% more for each hit, up to 50%. 10 mana, 12s cooldown.

masters_flurry.name: Master's Flurry
masters_flurry.desc: Strikes 6 times over 1.5s, each strike at one spot within 3.4 m of you, 2.4 m across, for 98% weapon damage each. Each strike picks the enemy with the lowest health. Changes with your shape or stance: Open Flurry (Open stance) and Closed Flurry (Closed stance). For 1.5s: -50% move speed; when it ends strikes everything in a 69° arc 3.4 m in front of you for 160% weapon damage; knocks targets back 4 m. 20 mana, 22s cooldown.

sanctified_blade.name: Sanctified Blade
sanctified_blade.desc: Strikes everything in an 80° arc 3.2 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 173% weapon damage as holy. Each enemy hit restores 2% of your maximum health. Deals 50% more damage to undead and fiends. 4 mana, 5s cooldown.

oath_hammer.name: Oath Hammer
oath_hammer.desc: Looses one bolt out to 26 m for 158% weapon damage as holy, splashing everything within 1.8 m of where the bolt lands. Flies back to you, striking everything on the way back for 80% of the damage. Each enemy hit restores 1% of your maximum health. Marks targets with Seared for 6s: they take 15% more damage from you. 10 mana, 8s cooldown.

martyrs_vow.name: Martyr's Vow
martyrs_vow.desc: Costs 15% of your maximum health, never taking you below 1 health. You and every follower get a barrier worth 25% of your maximum health for 8s. No mana cost, 20s cooldown.

shining_rebuke.name: Shining Repulse
shining_rebuke.desc: Strikes everything within 5 m of you for 270% weapon damage as holy. Knocks targets back 5 m and stuns them for 1s. Deals 50% more damage to undead and fiends. 16 mana, 14s cooldown.

daybreak_descent.name: Daybreak Descent
daybreak_descent.desc: Knocks targets back 3 m. Leaps up to 16 m to land beside the follower nearest your aim, striking nothing on the way. On landing, strikes everything within 6 m for 220% weapon damage and leaves a 8 m zone for 4s. Every follower heals 15% of its maximum health. 28 mana, 24s cooldown.

scale_rend.name: Scale Rend
scale_rend.desc: Strikes everything in a 103° arc 3.4 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 173% weapon damage as fire. Leaves the target Burning: a further 45% weapon damage over 5s. Its element and status follow your Wyrm Temper. 5 mana, 5s cooldown.

wyrmfall.name: Wyrmfall

recast.say: leap 14 m back the way you came

wyrmfall.desc: Knocks targets back 3 m. Leaps up to 14 m toward where you aim, striking nothing on the way. On landing, strikes everything within 5 m for 200% weapon damage. Its element and status follow your Wyrm Temper. 14 mana, 14s cooldown.

dragonscale.name: Dragonscale
dragonscale.desc: For 8s: melee attackers take 40% of the hit back. You get a barrier worth 25% of your maximum health for 8s. 12 mana, 22s cooldown.

wyrm_ascendant.name: Wyrm Ascendant
wyrm_ascendant.desc: Changes with your shape or stance: Frost Ascendant (Frost Temper) and Storm Ascendant (Storm Temper). For 10s your attacks deal 15% more damage as fire, apply Burning and splash everything within 3 m. 30 mana, 40s cooldown.

sworn_ward.name: Sworn Ward

recast.say: leap up to 15 m to the follower nearest your aim and make everything within 6 m of you attack you for 4s

sworn_ward.desc: Links the follower nearest your aim to you for 12s: you take 100% of the damage dealt to it above 20% of its health instead. 8 mana, 18s cooldown.

challenge.name: Challenge
challenge.desc: Strikes everything within 10 m of you for 172% weapon damage. Ranged targets are pulled 4 m toward you. Enemies within 10 m attack you for 4s. 6 mana, 12s cooldown.

rampart.name: Rampart

recast.say: topple the wall forward: everything in a 6 m wide strip 6 m ahead takes 200% weapon damage and is stunned for 1s

rampart.desc: Lands on a spot up to 8 m away. Raises a 6 m wall across where you aim for 8s: enemies cannot walk through it and enemy ranged hits through it are stopped. 12 mana, 20s cooldown.

unbroken_banner.name: Unbroken Banner
unbroken_banner.desc: Places a zone 20 m across where you stand for 12s, giving allies inside Guarded (takes 20% less damage) while they stay in it. For 12s, you and every follower: cannot drop below 1 health; when it ends heals you and your followers within it 20% of maximum health. Enemies within 10 m attack you for 12s. 30 mana, 60s cooldown.

rune_hammer.name: Rune Hammer
rune_hammer.desc: Strikes everything in an 80° arc 3.2 m in front of you, or as far and as wide as your weapon swings if that is more, for 173% weapon damage as arcane. Adds 1 Rune stack to each target hit, up to 3. 5 mana, 5s cooldown.

forge_flame.name: Forge Flame

recast.say: quench the metal and heal 15% of your maximum health

forge_flame.desc: For 12s your attacks deal 40% more damage as fire and apply Burning; every 4th attack bursts for 100% weapon damage within 3 m. 12 mana, 24s cooldown.

warding_glyph.name: Warding Glyph
warding_glyph.desc: Lands on a spot up to 14 m away. Places a zone 12 m across where you aim for 12s, giving allies inside Guarded (takes 25% less damage) while they stay in it, allies inside gain a barrier of 2% of maximum health every 1s, up to 15%. 16 mana, 20s cooldown.

great_anvil.name: The Great Anvil

recast.say: shatter the anvil: everything within 8 m of you takes 250% weapon damage and is knocked 4 m back

great_anvil.desc: Falls on a spot up to 20 m away, 1s after you cast, striking everything within 8 m of that spot for 1,498% weapon damage as arcane. Stuns targets for 2s. Places a post where you aim for 10s, each Rune Hammer hit within 8 m of the post rings the post for 120% weapon damage. 30 mana, 45s cooldown.

_r25Doc: R25: a skill's damage share is multiplied by js/skills.js effectiveMult — its unlock level (x1.0 at 1 to x2.0 at 24) and its cooldown (+8% per second past 4) — so a long wait and a late unlock buy a bigger hit. The late damage skills that had no debuff got one (Storm Beam shock, Arcane Burst curse, Rain of Arrows web, Whirlwind bleed, Execute and Charge weaken). Whirlwind spins five times at 80% (was one hit at 160%).
_r25NewDoc: R25 — seven new skills (Flamethrower, Ember Stride, Storm Orbs, Blizzard, Toxic Cloud, Judgement, Void Rift). New fields: `repeats`/`repeatEvery` on melee and ground (the whole strike again that many times), `breath` (drawn as a stream), `weather` (drawn as falling weather over the circle), `delay` (seconds between the cast and the hit landing), `pull` (metres every pulse drags a body toward the middle), `trail` (self: for `seconds` every step leaves `burns`-second burning ground `radius` wide), `orbs` (self: `count` orbs for `seconds`, each striking the nearest enemy within `radius` every `every` s for the skill's share, and laying `status`).
